question: Which of the following pairs of coast and the state in which it is located is INCORRECT?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Malabar coast – Tamil Nadu**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The Malabar coast is not in Tamil Nadu**.
 
• It is a long and narrow coastline, extending from the southern part of Goa to Kanyakumari in the south.
